features.description: CI gate: add security-audit job to ci.yml that fails PRs on new HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs in production deps (frontend+sandbox npm audit, backend pip-audit via uvx). Bump frontend job node 20→22.
acceptance_criteria: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high exits 0 in frontend/ and infrastructure/mcp-sandbox/
uvx pip-audit --requirement <(uv export --frozen --no-dev) --strict --vulnerability-service osv exits 0 in backend/
GitHub Actions run on dev HEAD shows the new security-audit job green
Audit job completes in under 90s
Node version bumped from 20 to 22 in the existing frontend job

features.description: Add scripts/security-check.sh + make security-check target + CLAUDE.md Automation Principle row, so devs can re-verify the gate locally.
acceptance_criteria: make security-check exits 0 against current dev HEAD
Per-ecosystem pass/fail clearly visible in output; trailing one-line summary
Script invokes the exact same commands as the CI gate's security-audit job
CLAUDE.md Automation Principle table includes a row for make security-check

features.description: Refactor M1's inline audit steps to invoke scripts/security-check.sh from M2. Single source of truth, drift-proof.
acceptance_criteria: CI security-audit job invokes scripts/security-check.sh rather than running inline audit commands
make security-check and the CI job produce identical pass/fail outcomes
Script header documents that it is the gate's single source of truth
features.notes: Numbered M5 to match design doc step 5; runs immediately after M2 to lock in single-source-of-truth before downstream work.

features.description: Weekly cron workflow .github/workflows/security-weekly.yml: Mon 09:00 UTC runs full audit (incl. dev deps) + queries dependabot alerts, opens/updates a rolling tracking issue.
acceptance_criteria: gh workflow run security-weekly.yml succeeds via workflow_dispatch
A single issue exists with title matching 'Security audit — week of YYYY-MM-DD'
Issue body contains audit summary + dependabot alert counts by severity + link to design doc
Re-running the workflow updates the existing issue rather than opening a duplicate
Workflow has minimum-required permissions (contents:read, issues:write, security-events:read)

features.description: aipla-security-checkup skill: .claude/skills/aipla-security-checkup/SKILL.md encoding the reachability rubric, per-ecosystem commands, override conflict pattern, and CI re-verification step.
acceptance_criteria: Skill file at .claude/skills/aipla-security-checkup/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (name, description, trigger phrases)
Body covers all four ecosystems (frontend npm, sandbox npm, backend Python, dependabot alerts via gh api)
Cross-references the design doc as policy source
CLAUDE.md Project Skills section lists the new skill
Skill is discoverable via Skill tool trigger phrases
